user.title: Connect Min Fotboll
user.description: The first test version uses the JWT_token from an already signed-in Min Fotboll browser session. Open browser developer tools, go to Application/Storage → Cookies for minfotboll.svenskfotboll.se and copy the JWT_token value. Direct phone number and SMS authentication is planned for a later version.

data_description.token_json: The complete JSON value containing AccessToken, RefreshToken, Expires and ServerTime.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Min Fotboll.
error.invalid_auth: The token could not be used. Sign in to Min Fotboll again and copy a new JWT_token.

abort.already_configured: This Min Fotboll account is already configured.
